scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler@4.102.0 deploy
scripts.preview: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler@4.102.0 dev
scripts.android:sync: npm run mobile:build && node scripts/ensure-capacitor-platform.mjs android && npx cap sync android && node scripts/prepare-android.mjs
scripts.android:open: npm run android:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:sync && node scripts/android-gradle.mjs assembleDebug
scripts.android:bundle: npm run android:sync && node scripts/android-gradle.mjs bundleRelease
scripts.ios:sync: npm run mobile:build && node scripts/ensure-capacitor-platform.mjs ios && npx cap sync ios && node scripts/prepare-ios.mjs
scripts.ios:open: npm run ios:sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.ios:sim: npm run ios:sync && node scripts/ios-xcodebuild.mjs simulator
scripts.ios:archive: npm run ios:sync && node scripts/ios-xcodebuild.mjs archive
